milestone: 4c: the police radio names a generated city's streets by their own names

tasks.goal: Fill streetWord(x, z) in src/sim/dispatch.js so the radio says the street names the lot note uses, make fill() use it for {street}, and drop the hand-written street list from dispatch.json and its check from the validator.
tasks.commit: feat(dispatch): the radio names a generated city's streets
tasks.notes: Four small edits, nothing else. (1) src/sim/dispatch.js streetWord body: `const id = streetAt(x, z); const avenue = AVENUES.find((w) => w.id === id); if (avenue) return `${streetName(avenue)} Avenue`; const crossing = CROSSINGS.find((w) => w.id === id); return crossing ? `${streetName(crossing)} Street` : '';` and delete the void lines and the comment's last sentence ('Milestone 4 skeleton: ... street list.'). (2) In fill(), `street: CHATTER.streets[streetAt(e.x, e.z)]` becomes `street: streetWord(e.x, e.z)`. (3) src/content/dispatch.json: delete the whole "streets" block (7 lines), leave every other line as it is. (4) scripts/validate_content.mjs: delete the line `checkWordMap(`${w}.streets`, data.streets, ...)` in checkDispatch and change the world.js import to `import { WALK_BOUNDS } from '../src/sim/world.js';`. tests/wanted.spec.js must stay green; npm run validate must pass.
